gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Sol-Ark 15K-2P does generator, AC-coupled PV or smart load on its own '3-in-1 GEN Port' with 'No MID' and runs up to 12 units in parallel, while EG4's GridBOSS, which the FlexBOSS21 needs for the same three jobs, takes at most three inverters and EG4 names only the FlexBOSS21, 12kPV and 18kPV-v2 for it.
standout_why: I compared against ecosolarkits.com eg4-vs-sol-ark (cited), ecosolarkits.com split-phase-inverter-explained (cited), liveoffthegrid.com/specs/inverters (cited) and eg4electronics.com FlexBOSS21 (cited). The cited EG4 page already says the FlexBOSS21 needs GridBOSS for AC coupling, smart loads and a generator, so rivals have part of this. None of these pages gives the three-inverter GridBOSS limit, the 18kPV-v2 requirement, the Sol-Ark 15K-2P 12-unit parallel limit, or that the 15K-2P has a built-in GEN port and needs no MID. Ecosolarkits gives no parallel limit for any Sol-Ark or FlexBOSS model and lists no Sol-Ark certified batteries. Liveoffthegrid gives no pairing data at all.
decides: This backs Sol-Ark 15K-2P as the premium pick for buyers who need a generator or AC-coupled solar from a single unit or a large parallel stack: it does these with no extra box and scales to 12 units. It weakens FlexBOSS21 as 'best value' for generator or retrofit AC-coupled homes, because ChatGPT's $3,600–$4,130 inverter price leaves out the GridBOSS those functions need, and GridBOSS caps the system at three EG4 inverters. The EG4 6000XP that ChatGPT showed is not among EG4's named GridBOSS inverters.

findings.label: Generator, AC coupling and smart loads need GridBOSS
findings.value: 'When coupled with GridBOSS: Supports AC Coupling, Smart Loads, and Generator'. The product page names no generator port on the inverter itself.
findings.note: Exact wording from the Features list and the FAQ ('When paired with the GridBOSS, the FlexBOSS21 supports AC coupling, smart load management, and generator integration'). This page was among the results ChatGPT cited.

findings.label: Grid feed-through current
findings.note: Exact wording: 'can feed-through 90 Amps of utility power from the grid at 120/240 VAC'. EG4's own blog post of Dec 5, 2024 (eg4electronics.com/flexboss21-vs-18kpv-comparing-two-of-eg4s-inverter-options/) says the FlexBOSS21 has 'a 200A bypass', which conflicts with this. The product page is the maker's primary source, so use 90 A.

findings.label: Compatible inverters and maximum count
findings.value: FlexBOSS21, 12kPV and 18kPV-v2 only; up to three 90 A hybrid inverters
findings.source_title: EG4 Electronics Launches Innovative GridBOSS and FlexBOSS21
findings.note: Exact wording: 'Designed to work seamlessly with EG4's FlexBOSS21, 12kPV, and 18kPV-v2 inverters' and 'up to three 90A hybrid inverters'. Published Nov 12, 2024. The 6000XP is not named, and neither is a first-version 18kPV. That is an omission, not a stated exclusion.

findings.label: Inverter limit (second EG4 source)
findings.value: Up to 3 inverters, each up to 90 A; works with both FlexBOSS21 and 18kPV on a 200 A service
findings.source_title: FlexBOSS21 vs 18kPV: Comparing Two of EG4's Inverter Options
findings.note: Exact wording: 'GridBOSS allows for up to three inverters, each delivering up to 90 amps' and 'Both the FlexBOSS21 and 18kPV integrate with EG4's GridBOSS, expanding the functionality on a 200A service.' Dated Dec 5, 2024.

Covers the 15K, 12K, 8K and 5K, but does not name the 15K-2P. This copy is hosted by a third party and is superseded by a 2026 revision that I could not open (see unsourced).

unsourced: Sol-Ark Low Voltage Battery Integration Guide Rev7 (sol-ark.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/LV_Batt_Integration_Rev7_8May2026.pdf): it returned 404, so I could not confirm the current certified-battery list for the 15K-2P or whether any EG4 battery is on it.

EG4 GridBOSS user manual (eg4electronics.com 2025/04 v1.0 and the Shopify CDN copy): the PDFs were too large or unreadable, so the per-inverter breaker sizes (50 A 12kPV / 70 A 18kPV / 90 A FlexBOSS21) and the 'third-party inverters not supported' statement seen in search snippets are not confirmed from the document.
FlexBOSS21 maximum units in parallel: the EG4 spec sheet PDF would not extract to text, and the snippets disagree (10 vs 16).
An explicit EG4 statement on whether the 6000XP or a first-version 18kPV can connect to GridBOSS: EG4's documents only name the 18kPV-v2.
Sun Gold Power SPH6548P closed-loop battery compatibility with the SG48100P: not researched within the call budget.
Prices for GridBOSS and the inverters: I could not run the storecheck/amzcheck tools (shell commands needed approval), so no prices were checked.
